questions.q: Which of the following factors is most critical when choosing a physical location for a mobile phone workshop to ensure a steady stream of new business?
options: Being located directly next to a hospital.
High foot traffic and storefront visibility.
Choosing a secluded area to minimize commercial rent.
Having an unbranded, hidden entrance for security.
questions.explain: A location with high foot traffic and high visibility naturally attracts more potential walk-in customers to the repair shop, which is essential for a service-oriented business.
questions.exam: WASSCE Setting Up and Managing Mobile Phone Workshop
questions.subject: Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1

questions.q: When actively evaluating potential commercial properties to establish a profitable GSM repair workshop, which condition would severely limit potential revenue growth?
options: Opening a shop physically inside a massive centralized technology or electronics market hub.
Renting a large building in an industrial sector located far away from populated urban residential zones.
Selecting a storefront with easily accessible curbside parking for visiting walk-in clients.
Installing massive, highly visible illuminated signage directly on a busy main street.
questions.explain: Mobile phone repair is primarily a direct consumer service. Establishing the shop physically far from heavy population centers or residential communities drastically throttles customer acquisition and subsequent business.

questions.q: A repair CEO executing demographic heat-map analysis identifies their newly rented workshop sits directly adjacent to a densely populated college campus. Which targeted commercial retail and service strategy strictly capitalizes on this specific neighborhood reality to yield maximized revenue?
options: Aggressively transforming the lobby strictly to service elite billionaires by executing intricate 24-karat solid-gold-plated chassis modifications.
Rapidly optimizing local inventory lines to intensely push 15-minute express glass replacements, affordable budget battery swaps, and heavy sales of refurbished mid-tier laptops/phones.
Completely gutting the inventory systems to singularly service antiquated rotary landline telecommunication devices.
Establishing an exclusive 'ship-in only' architecture where local students endure mandatory three-week international overseas part delays.
questions.explain: Hyper-local demographic analysis reveals university students universally demand massive affordability combined with instant gratification for core communication devices. Heavy stocking of fast-moving commodity parts like budget screens directly captures this explosive, high-volume market segment.
